edits.old: Then only the values of LOV-LEGAL-TYPE and LOV-LEGAL-STATUS are written and no person name, address, contact value or identity number is written
edits.new:
Then only the values of LOV-LEGAL-TYPE and LOV-LEGAL-STATUS are written and no person name, address, contact value or identity number is written

  Scenario: AC8 Error answers of the provided operations
    Given a provided operation of section 12 receives a request that it refuses
    When the operation answers
    Then the operation answers with status 401, 403 or 404 as the refusal requires and with no other error status

  Scenario: AC9 Replay of a write with the same Idempotency-Key
    Given the write of a fact has been accepted with an Idempotency-Key
    When the same Idempotency-Key is replayed for the write
    Then the first answer is returned, the write is made once and the repeat is counted

  Scenario: AC10 Activity retry and timeout
    Given an activity of LitigationWorkflow is retried or times out during the enforcement step
    When the retry or the timeout occurs
    Then the decision record and the case-move answer are each written at most once and the repeat is counted
